    VIDEO: Iran’s NSC committee chairman slams Trump’s blockade in interview with The Grayzone

    Wyatt Reed·May 4, 2026

    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 33:34
    Instaread

    In an exclusive interview in Tehran with The Grayzone’s Wyatt Reed, the chair of Iran’s parliamentary National Security Committee, Ebrahim Azizi, discussed his country’s plans to implement a new regulatory framework over the Strait of Hormuz in the face of renewed aggression by the US military and threats by President Donald Trump.

    Azizi also offers his thoughts on the viability of the US military presence in the region, Israeli influence over the Trump administration, and the rift between Europe and the US.
